information.description:
When a cyberpsycho incident occurs, occasionally NCPD has to respond before MAX-TAC can. In the rare times when this happens, NCPD armories provide even heavier armaments and gear to tactical unit members that have the strength to shoulder them.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Ncpd).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

After years of being outgunned, NCPD’s SWAT requested a new weapon that wouldn’t clash with MAX-TAC’s kill credit. Constitutional Arms responded with the Heavy Auto Rifle (HAR), a hybrid LMG/Battle rifle featuring modernized .30-06 ammo, a 20mm launcher, holosights, and a lightweight bipod. It’s been in service, and getting stolen, since January of 2077.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Machine Gun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Short Scope), Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Non-Basic Ammunition. When rolling for Autofire damage with this weapon, roll 3d6 and drop the lowest roll before applying the multiplier. Requires BODY 8+ to wield unless Mounted.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Short Scope), Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Functions like a standard grenade launcher, but with a magazine size of 1. Requires 2 hands to use, and takes up 2 attachment slots. While attached, the weapon can't be concealed under clothing.

Note that the weapon inherits any modifiers from the gun it is attached to, such as other attachments and quality.
Heavier version of an Armorjack for your head. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) for 10 Arrows or Shotgun Shells

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) for 1 Grenade or Rocket

With the newest innovations in nano-batteries and electric field dispersions there’s a multitude of new methods for injecting a few thousand volts into chromed-out body. Disabling a cyberpsycho’s speedware while blasting off a limb has never been easier!

Functions as EMP Ammunition (CRB, pg. 346) which still deals damage, but does not ablate SP or cause Critical Injuries. Any damage dealt by this ammunition is reduced by 1d6 (minimum 2d6) against any target with 1 or more SP, unless the target is a drone or FBC, in which case the damage is not reduced.

Stack: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
Handcuffs meant for borgs. Disables any Non-Hardened Cyberware options installed in the limb the cuffs are binding. BODY≥13 can break.
Eyewear with two options slots for cybereye options.
Must be paired. Ignore any vision penalties due to lighting or fog/smoke.
